Indonesian Description: Skema okupasi Cloud Engineer mencakup kompetensi dalam merancang, menyediakan, dan mengoperasikan infrastruktur cloud pada AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, atau platform hybrid. Meliputi pemilihan layanan cloud, konfigurasi sumber daya komputasi dan jaringan, penerapan kontrol keamanan, otomatisasi deployment dengan infrastructure-as-code, monitoring biaya dan reliabilitas, serta integrasi komponen cloud dengan sistem on-premise.
English Description: The Cloud Engineer occupational role covers competencies in designing, provisioning, and operating cloud infrastructure on AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, or hybrid platforms. It includes selecting cloud services, configuring compute and networking resources, implementing security controls, automating deployments with infrastructure-as-code, monitoring cost and reliability, and integrating cloud components with on-premises systems. Common skills include AWS Lambda, EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, Terraform, CloudFormation, GCP services, and Azure resources.

Indonesian Description: Skema okupasi Cloud Solutions Architect mencakup kompetensi merancang arsitektur cloud end-to-end yang memenuhi kebutuhan bisnis, keamanan, dan skalabilitas pada satu atau beberapa provider cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure). Meliputi definisi solution patterns, evaluasi trade-off antar layanan, perencanaan strategi migrasi dari on-premise ke cloud, kepastian compliance dengan kebijakan keamanan dan cost management, serta panduan teknis untuk tim engineering selama implementasi.
English Description: The Cloud Solutions Architect occupational role covers competencies in designing end-to-end cloud architectures that meet business, security, and scalability requirements across one or more cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure). It includes defining solution patterns, evaluating trade-offs between services, planning migration strategies from on-premises to cloud, ensuring compliance with security and cost-management policies, and guiding engineering teams through implementation. Multi-cloud and hybrid architectures are common.
Source Type: Community-defined (non-official) — covers gaps in current SKKNI ICT catalogue

Indonesian Description: Skema okupasi DevOps Engineer mencakup kompetensi otomatisasi software delivery pipelines (CI/CD), pengelolaan infrastructure-as-code dengan tools seperti Terraform atau Ansible, orkestrasi kontainer dengan Kubernetes atau Docker, monitoring sistem produksi, penerapan release strategies, serta kolaborasi antar tim development dan operations untuk meningkatkan deployment frequency dan reliabilitas.
English Description: The DevOps Engineer occupational role covers competencies in automating software delivery pipelines (CI/CD), managing infrastructure-as-code with tools such as Terraform or Ansible, orchestrating containers with Kubernetes or Docker, monitoring production systems, implementing release strategies, and collaborating across development and operations to improve deployment frequency and reliability. Common practices include GitOps, blue-green deployments, observability, and incident response.

Indonesian Description: Skema okupasi Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) mencakup kompetensi mengoperasikan sistem produksi skala besar dengan fokus pada reliabilitas, skalabilitas, dan observability. Meliputi definisi service-level objectives (SLO/SLI), otomatisasi operational toil, perancangan prosedur incident response, pembangunan observability via metrics/logs/traces, blameless postmortems, serta penerapan praktik software engineering untuk masalah infrastruktur.
English Description: The Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) occupational role covers competencies in operating large-scale production systems with a focus on reliability, scalability, and observability. It includes defining service-level objectives (SLOs/SLIs), automating operational toil, designing incident response procedures, building observability with metrics/logs/traces, conducting blameless postmortems, and applying software engineering practices to infrastructure problems. Overlaps with DevOps but emphasises long-running production health.

Indonesian Description: Skema okupasi Frontend Developer mencakup kompetensi membangun aplikasi web user-facing menggunakan framework JavaScript modern (React, Angular, Vue), HTML5, CSS3, dan prinsip responsive design. Meliputi implementasi UI berbasis komponen, pengelolaan client-side state, integrasi dengan REST atau GraphQL API, kepastian cross-browser compatibility, optimasi performance, dan penerapan standar accessibility (WCAG).
English Description: The Frontend Developer occupational role covers competencies in building user-facing web applications using modern JavaScript frameworks (React, Angular, Vue, Svelte), HTML5, CSS3, and responsive design principles. It includes implementing component-based UIs, managing client-side state, integrating with REST or GraphQL APIs, ensuring cross-browser compatibility, optimising performance, and applying accessibility (WCAG) standards. TypeScript adoption is common.

Indonesian Description: Skema okupasi Backend Developer mencakup kompetensi merancang dan mengimplementasikan logika aplikasi server-side, API, dan integrasi database menggunakan bahasa dan framework seperti Java, C#/.NET, ASP.NET, Python, Node.js, atau Go. Meliputi penulisan RESTful atau GraphQL API, penanganan authentication dan authorization, pengelolaan database transactions, optimasi query, serta integrasi dengan message queues, caching layers, dan external services.
English Description: The Backend Developer occupational role covers competencies in designing and implementing server-side application logic, APIs, and database integration using languages and frameworks such as Java, C#/.NET, ASP.NET, Python, Node.js, or Go. It includes writing RESTful or GraphQL APIs, handling authentication and authorisation, managing database transactions, optimising query performance, and integrating with message queues, caching layers, and external services. Microservices and event-driven patterns are common.
Source Type: Community-defined (non-official) — covers gaps in current SKKNI ICT catalogue

Indonesian Description: Skema okupasi Full-Stack Developer mencakup kompetensi membangun aplikasi web lengkap dari frontend hingga backend. Meliputi penggunaan framework JavaScript untuk UI (React, Angular), bahasa server-side untuk API (Node.js, Python, C#, Java), perancangan dan integrasi database (SQL atau NoSQL), penerapan authentication, deployment ke cloud, serta pengelolaan delivery end-to-end dari satu codebase.
English Description: The Full-Stack Developer occupational role covers competencies in building complete web applications across frontend and backend layers. It includes using JavaScript frameworks for UI (React, Angular), server-side languages for APIs (Node.js, Python, C#, Java), designing and integrating databases (SQL or NoSQL), implementing authentication, deploying to cloud, and managing end-to-end delivery from one codebase.

Meliputi implementasi UI mobile, pengelolaan application state, integrasi sensor dan API device, optimasi performance dan baterai, penanganan skenario offline-first, serta publikasi melalui app store.
English Description: The Mobile Application Developer occupational role covers competencies in building native or cross-platform mobile applications for Android (Kotlin, Java) and iOS (Swift, Objective-C), or with cross-platform frameworks such as React Native or Flutter. It includes implementing mobile UI patterns, managing application state, integrating device sensors and APIs, optimising for performance and battery, handling offline-first scenarios, and shipping through app stores.

Indonesian Description: Skema okupasi UI/UX Designer mencakup kompetensi melakukan riset kebutuhan pengguna, merancang interaction flow, prototyping antarmuka, penerapan systems thinking pada desain produk, dan kepastian accessibility lintas produk digital. Meliputi user research dan interview, information architecture, wireframing dan prototyping di tools seperti Figma, usability testing, penerapan design system, serta kolaborasi dengan developer dan tim produk.
English Description: The UI/UX Designer occupational role covers competencies in researching user needs, designing interaction flows, prototyping interfaces, applying systems thinking to product design, and ensuring accessibility across digital products. It includes user research and interviews, information architecture, wireframing and prototyping in tools such as Figma, conducting usability testing, applying design systems, and collaborating with developers and product teams. WCAG accessibility, design tokens, and interaction patterns are core skills.

Indonesian Description: Skema okupasi Machine Learning Engineer mencakup kompetensi merancang, melatih, dan mendeploy model machine learning untuk penggunaan produksi. Meliputi pemilihan algoritma dan arsitektur, persiapan training dataset, training dan evaluasi model menggunakan framework seperti TensorFlow atau PyTorch, optimasi inference model, pembangunan inference service dan API, serta monitoring performa model di produksi. Berbeda dari Data Scientist dengan fokus pada productionisation dan engineering.
English Description: The Machine Learning Engineer occupational role covers competencies in designing, training, and deploying machine learning models for production use. It includes selecting algorithms and architectures, preparing training datasets, training and evaluating models using frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch, optimising model inference, building inference services and APIs, and monitoring model performance in production. Distinct from Data Scientist in its focus on productionisation, engineering rigour, and integration with broader software systems.

Indonesian Description: Skema okupasi NLP / Language Model Engineer mencakup kompetensi membangun aplikasi yang menggunakan natural language processing atau large language models. Meliputi pemilihan dan fine-tuning model pretrained, implementasi prompt engineering dan retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), evaluasi output model untuk tugas klasifikasi, generation, atau sequence analysis, serta integrasi language model ke dalam sistem produksi.
English Description: The NLP / Language Model Engineer occupational role covers competencies in building applications that use natural language processing or large language models. It includes selecting and fine-tuning pretrained models, implementing prompt engineering and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), evaluating model outputs for classification, generation, retrieval, or sequence tasks, and integrating language models into production systems. Common skills include transformer architectures, embeddings, vector databases, and chain-of-thought prompting.

Indonesian Description: Skema okupasi MLOps Engineer mencakup kompetensi mengoperasionalisasi model machine learning. Meliputi pembangunan ML pipeline untuk data ingestion, training, dan deployment; pengelolaan model versioning dan experiment tracking; deployment model skala besar di cloud atau on-premises; monitoring model drift dan retraining; serta integrasi sistem ML dengan CI/CD dan observability platform.
English Description: The MLOps Engineer occupational role covers competencies in operationalising machine learning models. It includes building ML pipelines for data ingestion, training, and deployment; managing model versioning and experiment tracking with tools like MLflow or Weights & Biases; deploying models at scale on cloud or on-premises infrastructure; monitoring model drift and retraining; and integrating ML systems with CI/CD and observability platforms.

Indonesian Description: Skema okupasi Solutions Architect mencakup kompetensi merancang solusi software end-to-end yang mengintegrasikan banyak sistem, teknologi, dan stakeholder. Meliputi pengumpulan kebutuhan, evaluasi trade-off teknis, perancangan integration pattern antar enterprise system, definisi data flow dan API, serta produksi dokumentasi arsitektur yang memandu tim engineering.
English Description: The Solutions Architect occupational role covers competencies in designing end-to-end software solutions that integrate multiple systems, technologies, and stakeholders. It includes gathering requirements, evaluating technical trade-offs, designing integration patterns between enterprise systems, defining data flows and APIs, and producing architectural documentation that guides engineering teams. Broader than System Analyst, with emphasis on cross-system integration and architectural choice.

Indonesian Description: Skema okupasi Engineering Tech Lead mencakup kompetensi kepemimpinan teknis dalam tim software engineering. Meliputi mentoring engineer, definisi technical standard dan review practice, kepemilikan keputusan arsitektur, koordinasi delivery lintas sprint, pemecahan masalah kompleks menjadi tugas yang dapat dikerjakan, serta keseimbangan antara hands-on engineering dengan tanggung jawab team-facing.
English Description: The Engineering Tech Lead occupational role covers competencies in technical leadership within a software engineering team. It includes mentoring engineers, defining technical standards and review practices, owning architectural decisions, coordinating delivery across sprints, breaking down complex problems into actionable tasks, and balancing hands-on engineering work with team-facing responsibilities. Bridges individual contributor work and engineering management.

Indonesian Description: Skema okupasi QA / Test Engineer mencakup kompetensi memastikan kualitas software melalui testing sistematis. Meliputi penulisan test plan dan test case, pembangunan automated test suite (unit, integration, end-to-end), performance dan security testing, reproduksi dan pelaporan defect, serta integrasi test ke CI/CD pipeline menggunakan tools seperti Selenium, Cypress, JUnit, atau pytest.
English Description: The QA / Test Engineer occupational role covers competencies in ensuring software quality through systematic testing. It includes writing test plans and test cases, building automated test suites (unit, integration, end-to-end), performing performance and security testing, reproducing and reporting defects, and integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Selenium, Cypress, JUnit, or pytest. SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test) is the senior variant.

Indonesian Description: Skema okupasi Information Security Engineer mencakup kompetensi mengamankan sistem dan jaringan organisasi melampaui Cyber Security Specialist tradisional. Meliputi implementasi identity and access management (IAM), penerapan secure coding practice, vulnerability assessment dan penetration testing, incident response, security monitoring dengan SIEM, dan kepastian compliance dengan ISO 27001 atau standar keamanan lain.
English Description: The Information Security Engineer occupational role covers competencies in securing organisational systems and networks beyond the scope of the traditional Cyber Security Specialist. It includes implementing identity and access management (IAM), applying secure coding practices, vulnerability assessment and penetration testing, incident response, security monitoring with SIEM tools, and ensuring compliance with ISO 27001 or other security standards.

Indonesian Description: Skema okupasi Game Developer mencakup kompetensi merancang dan mengimplementasikan sistem video game. Meliputi pemrograman game logic dan mechanics dengan engine seperti Unity (C#) atau Unreal (C++), implementasi sistem rendering dan physics, integrasi aset audio dan animation, optimasi untuk platform target (PC, console, mobile), serta kolaborasi dengan artist, designer, dan producer.
English Description: The Game Developer occupational role covers competencies in designing and implementing video game systems. It includes programming game logic and mechanics with engines such as Unity (C#) or Unreal (C++), implementing rendering and physics systems, integrating audio and animation assets, optimising for target platforms (PC, console, mobile), and collaborating with artists, designers, and producers. Indonesia's game-development industry includes both indie studios and outsourcing for international publishers.

Indonesian Description: Skema okupasi Embedded Systems Engineer mencakup kompetensi merancang dan memprogram software yang berjalan pada sistem embedded dan IoT. Meliputi pemrograman dalam C atau C++ pada microcontroller (ARM, AVR, ESP32), perancangan firmware, komunikasi dengan sensor dan aktuator, optimasi memory dan power, integrasi dengan protokol wireless (Bluetooth, LoRa, WiFi), serta pengujian pada hardware target.
English Description: The Embedded Systems Engineer occupational role covers competencies in designing and programming software that runs on embedded systems and IoT devices. It includes programming in C or C++ on microcontrollers (ARM, AVR, ESP32), designing firmware, communicating with sensors and actuators, optimising for memory and power constraints, integrating with wireless protocols (Bluetooth, LoRa, WiFi), and testing on target hardware. Often involves RF / wireless performance characterisation in labs.
